item.title: This Week in the Peace – Ducks Unlimited & The Crystal Cup
item.description: Today on This Week in the Peace, Bruce Harrison from Ducks Unlimited checks in to talk about the situation unfolding with the future of Inga Lake as the dam desperately needs repair but there's no funding in place to do so. Then, Neil Evans has been meticulously organizing this year's edition of the Crystal Cup, so he'll stop by to tell us all about the annual pond hockey tournament happening on Charlie Lake from February 20-22.
